from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EquityRecord(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in the financial report")
    equity_line_item: str = Field(description="The line item label for equity attributable to parent, as written in the report")
    equity_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount of equity attributable to parent company shareholders")
    equity_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount (e.g., '元', '百万元')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this equity figure")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/certification code if available in the report")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    equity_records: list[EquityRecord]
